messages.subject: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hallo,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is good to hear from Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH. We have looked at your request carefully for our shop. We can offer you a price of €36.00 per unit. 

We always aim to deliver top quality from our machines for your orders, and we look forward to working together on this project. Let us know if this works for you.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Dear colleagues at Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH,

Thank you for your offer, which we have compared with the other offers we hold for this part.

Your defect rate over the last four quarters stands at 1863 ppm (sc:70210@2026Q3). German producer prices for electric power generation, transmission and distribution changed -3.7% from 2025-08 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-08, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).

We are weighing several offers for this part; the options below would make yours the one we choose. A competing supplier has offered EUR 31.50 per unit (offer:70240-0).

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 28.07 per unit, payment 90 days net, lead time 35 days.
Option B: EUR 27.70 per unit, payment 30 days net, lead time 35 days.
Option C: EUR 27.79 per unit, payment 45 days net, lead time 35 days.

Could you share a cost breakdown for this part - material, conversion, overhead?

We would like to work with you and look forward to an offer we can compare favourably.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:

We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. 

We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price. I don't have a fancy cost breakdown for you, we just calculate based on our machine time and material. Material accounts for about 34 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. 

We have to stick to 30 days payment, longer terms are not possible for us. So, our Angebot is a price of €30.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH
